name: Lyra Windrunner
bio: The swiftest ranger in the realm. Quiet as a shadow, fast as the wind.

name: Valerius the Bold
bio: A legendary knight known for his courage and impeccable armor. Seeking companionship in the Tavern.

name: Elara Brightsoul
bio: A wandering bard with a voice like silver and a heart of gold. Exploring the world one ballad at a time.

name: Sylvana Moonwhisper
bio: A druid connected to the ancient spirits of the forest.

name: Thrain Ironfoot
bio: A master blacksmith from the deep mountains. Strength and honor above all else.

name: Borin Stonehammer
bio: A dwarven miner who values a good ale as much as a rare gem.

name: Kaelen Duskwood
bio: A mysterious warlock who walks the line between light and shadow.

name: Seraphina Starbound
bio: An aspiring astronomer who believes the stars hold the key to the future.

name: Garrick Bloodbane
bio: A battle-worn mercenary looking for a reason to put down the sword.

name: Isolde Stormcall
bio: A powerful sorceress who can summon lightning with a flick of her wrist.

name: Cedric of the Iron Guard
bio: A disciplined soldier dedicated to protecting the innocent.

name: Miriel Leafdancer
bio: An elven archer who finds peace in the rustle of leaves.

name: Torin Fireforge
bio: A boisterous dwarf with a passion for mechanical inventions.

name: Eowyn of the Steppes
bio: A fierce shield-maiden from the wide plains.

name: Mordred Shadowhand
bio: A cunning rogue who knows every secret alleyway in the city.

name: Alaric the Wise
bio: An elderly scholar who has spent decades studying ancient runes.

name: Rowan Oakheart
bio: A sturdy woodsman who knows the forest like the back of his hand.

name: Freya Frostbite
bio: A wanderer from the frozen north, surviving against the odds.
